about: Report a dispute between a private-sector employer and employee to the Ministry.
note: Requirements read from the official MOHRE service page on the checked date. Field labels sit behind sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Employer or employee can file when the other breaks contract obligations
Employee must be in the Ministry's database
No new complaint if the employee already has a pending complaint or court case, unless employment continues or the permit is to be cancelled
documents: Evidence for the claim if any, such as a resignation or dismissal letter
Employee's passport number, name, date of birth, nationality and ID card number
Employers add their establishment or licence number
